basic_info.description: Welcome to modern living at 2175 Quesada Avenue in Silver Terrace neighborhood of San Francisco! This newly constructed home, completed in 2022, showcases a modern architectural design that truly stands out. With 5 spacious bedrooms and 3 beautifully appointed bathrooms, this home is crafted for ease and comfort. Open floor plan and soaring ceilings bathe every room in natural light. The heart of this home is a state-of-the-art kitchen, featuring a sleek island with a quartz countertop, a built-in panel-ready fridge, and a gas cooktop, along with abundant cabinet space. Thoughtfully designed for modern living, the home is equipped with advanced security features, an alarm system, and a high-quality sound system to enhance your lifestyle. Step out onto a lovely deck from the main floor that opens up to a low-maintenance backyard, perfect for entertaining or enjoying a peaceful retreat, while lower floor also offers convenient backyard access. With laundry on the main floor and separate entrances for the lower level, the home offers rental income potential or a cozy guest suite option. This home is a perfect blend of modern elegance, artistic design, and practical amenities, offering a wonderful living experience in Silver Terrace neighborhood!
